description: Create a DM automation rule. trigger_type: comment_keyword (comment → DM; REQUIRES opening_message + button_label — Meta's two-step opt-in, enforced), dm_keyword, story_reply_keyword, default_reply, or ref_link (campaign DM link; Instagram requires conversation starters on the account, verified at create — a 502 means the check could not run, retry). Sending always goes through the platform's pacing engine; there is no send-a-DM-now tool.

active.description: Default true. Set false to create paused.

ai_enabled.description: AI-composed replies (not for comment_keyword). Requires ai_prompt.

button_label.description: comment_keyword: the opt-in button text. Required for comment_keyword.

keywords.description: Trigger keywords (required for *_keyword triggers; the campaign name for ref_link).

opening_message.description: comment_keyword: the opt-in DM shown with the button. Required for comment_keyword.

public_reply_variants.description: comment_keyword only: public comment replies (e.g. "Check your DMs!").

reply_variants.description: DM reply message(s) — one is rotated per send. Required unless ai_enabled.

name: create_dm_automation
